joints._format_note: Each joint is keyed exactly as distribution_report.py prints it (e.g. 'identity.occupation_tier x identity.education'), and maps 'valueA|valueB' -> probability. Joints are where contamination hides (a graduate-degree mason is invisible in marginals); fill these from PLFS (occupation x education) and NFHS-5 (children x age) and they become hard gates.
